/api/galaxy/{name}/empire.summary: Every world a player holds in this galaxy, caught up
/api/galaxy/{name}/empire.description: One read for a whole empire in a galaxy. POST because each world is caught up before being serialized, exactly like /api/territory/<id>/update: resources are credited when a world is looked at, so a listing without the catch-up would report the stocks of the last visit. Each world carries its buildings, the defenses posed, the running yards (events) and what holds its orbit (orbit). The body may carry `player` to read the empire of ANOTHER player, which only a moderator of this galaxy may do; the answer says whose empire it is (player), whether it is read as a referee (moderating), and whether one may pick another (can_moderate).

/api/galaxy/{name}/players.summary: Who holds something in this galaxy (moderation)
/api/galaxy/{name}/players.description: The list a moderator picks from to open a player's empire. Restricted to a moderator of this galaxy, and to administrators. A name and a world count, nothing more: enough to point at someone, not an account sheet.

/api/territory/{territory_id}/grant.summary: Place or take back an element, instantly and for free
/api/territory/{territory_id}/grant.description: A referee's gesture: repair a game, give back what an anomaly ate, try out a balance pass. No cost, no yard, no technology prerequisite -- only the rule of PLACE still holds, since a world that cannot carry something would produce nothing from it. Body: kind (building, defense or ship), name (the enum member), and a signed amount -- negative takes back, never below zero. Restricted to a moderator of the galaxy the world belongs to. Every call writes a moderation.grant line naming the target, the world, the element and the amount. Answers with the whole world, in the shape of the empire view.
